In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the bifactor structure was supported for the MRNI, and that the bifactor model is a viable alternative to the traditional factor analytic approach for assessing the construct validity of the instrument.
the MRNI-S-F has a bifactor structure that is consistent with the original 46-item MRNI, and that the General Traditional Masculine Norm factor of the MRNI has construct validity.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the bifactor model is a powerful and flexible tool for assessing the construct validity of a scale, and that the MRNI-SFs construct validity was supported in this study.
we found support for the construct validity of the General factor and most of the specific factors of the MRNI.
the bifactor model of the MRNI-Short Form (SF) is a valid approach to construct validation of the MRNI.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have shown that the bifactor model is an effective tool to use in evaluating the construct validity of a measurement instrument.
a latent variable approach to construct validity is a viable and potentially more powerful approach to evaluating the validity evidence for a measure than is a traditional variable-based approach.
the MRNI-S-F is a psychometrically sound instrument for assessing the construct of traditional masculinity in men.
